system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Deal [3D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target, and the target takes [Decay: [INT mod]]. This [Decay] does not overwrite [Decay] effect the target is already affected by, and instead adds to its rating.

An offensive magic that releases the raging soul and the soul that seeks peace from a formation that imitates a magatama, and shoots through the enemy with its torrent. The rivalry of the yin and yang magatama is reduced while looking at the existence of the object.
